fullDescription: Renders the dashboard-home view in its default state as the main application route, showing the three-column developer dashboard layout with the connected top navigation, repository sidebar, feed, and right-side information cards.

Provides the dashboard-home screen with a state prop supporting the default layout, interactive top and sidebar search fields, a multiline AI prompt composer, selectable prompt controls, feed cards for repository recommendations, and a right rail with promotional and changelog cards. The component is reusable as a presentational dashboard view with configurable initial prompt content and serializable state.
